{{Quote|Two maladjusted want-to-be bounty hunters and their dressed-up protocol droid.|Valin Horn, to Vrannin Vaxx, Dhidal Nyz, and their companion, upon jumping onto Nyz's cargo hauler|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
'''Vrannin Vaxx''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]]. He won fame during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], but was nearly [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a personnel [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crash near the end of the war. His family obtained a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[YVH 1]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and made it into a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] body for Vaxx.

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Vaxx, along with a [[Unidentified Human bounty hunter (Valin Horn)|female]] Human [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] inventor [[Dhidal Nyz]], was hired by [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to capture the fugitive [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]]. During the hunt, Vaxx was [[Laser/Legends|shot]], and the hunters' [[Cargo hauler/Legends|vehicle]] was disabled by ex-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his wife, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], forcing the hunters to give up the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]]. Horn was captured by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and eventually returned to the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]]. Vaxx was later hired alongside bounty hunter [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]] by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] to assist in the arrest of Valin Horn from the Temple.

==Biography==
{{Quote|That YVH droid could be bad news.|Han Solo|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
Vrannin Vaxx was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] born on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]],<ref name="Outcast" /> in the [[Videnda sector/Legends|Videnda sector]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> He became a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and distinguished himself during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], but suffered grievous injuries when his personnel [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crashed late in the war. Two-thirds of his body was destroyed beyond repair, but instead of replacing it with simple [[Cybernetics/Legends|prostheses]], Vaxx's wealthy family&mdash;a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] clan&mdash;acquired a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[YVH 1]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and reassembled it into a cybernetic body for Vaxx.<ref name="Outcast" />

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'' to [[43 ABY]]</ref> Vaxx and two other [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]&mdash;a [[Unidentified Human bounty hunter (Valin Horn)|blond]] female Human and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] inventor [[Dhidal Nyz]]&mdash;in a [[Cargo hauler/Legends|cargo hauler]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Unidentified pilot (Valin Horn)|another being]], were hired by [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] as a part of [[Daala's special-missions force|her special-missions force]]. They were ordered to capture the fugitive [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]], who was suffering from a [[Force psychosis|psychological]] breakdown. During the chase through the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Horn ejected from the antique [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] he had been flying and landed his [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejector seat]] on the cargo hauler's bed. Before the bounty hunters could attack him, however, they were distracted by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] as she jumped down from her [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] onto the bed in hopes of catching Horn. Horn quickly escaped on his ejector seat, and Solo landed where Horn had been standing a moment before. Vaxx reassured Solo that they weren't there to hurt her, but Nyz fired his electric net gun at the Jedi. The net caught Solo and knocked her over the edge of the cargo bed. The female bounty hunter began to criticize Nyz for his rash action, but a racing [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] shot by the hauler, causing the vehicle to tip over sideways. Nyz was thrown off the hauler and their female colleague lost her balance, but Vaxx held his footing.<ref name="Outcast" />

As they began to accelerate back up to speed, Vaxx opened fire on Solo and her companion, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]], in their speeder. However, the hunters were quickly [[Laser/Legends|fired]] upon by former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his wife, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], in their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Vaxx was hit, and the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] was launched into the control cab of the cargo hauler. Smoke began pouring from the cab and the hauler slowed down. The bounty hunters were forced to give up the chase, but Vaxx survived the accident and was quickly repaired. Soon after, Horn was captured by Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and eventually placed in the [[Temple of the Sith|Jedi Temple]]. Before long, Vaxx was hired by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], alongside fellow bounty hunter [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]], to accompany [[Galactic Alliance Security]] forces led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Oric Harfard]] to the Jedi Temple to arrest Valin Horn. Horn was then put on [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|trial]], convicted, [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encased]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], and placed in the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]], a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on Coruscant.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We're not here to harm you."''<br />''"Just what have you been programmed for?|Vaxx and Jaina Solo|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
Vrannin Vaxx was terribly injured in a shuttle crash near the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War and had his irreparably damaged body replaced with that of a YVH 1 droid. While he wasn't able to carry as much weaponry as a normal YVH droid due to his smaller carapace, he made up for it with his cunning and experience. He often worked with other bounty hunters and was also employed by the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vrannin Vaxx appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', a [[2009]] novel written [[Aaron Allston]] as the first in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Outcast" />
